title: Swift macOS telemetry package
spec: Build a Swift 6 package for macOS 14+ containing a telemetry domain library, async streaming ingestion, bounded task-group aggregation, a command-line report tool, tests, and a minimal SwiftUI-facing view-model module that compiles without launching a simulator. Generate 300,000 deterministic JSONL records in 8 shards.
prompts: Create the Swift package, Sendable domain model, parser contracts, CLI target, and focused XCTest coverage.
Implement deterministic 300,000-record generation and AsyncSequence streaming ingestion across 8 shards.
Add bounded task-group aggregation with stable results and tests matching sequential execution.
Add schema migration, malformed-record reporting, and a SwiftUI-compatible observable dashboard view model without starting a simulator.
Run tests, strict concurrency checks where supported, a measured pipeline run, and release build. Fix failures and write BENCHMARK_RESULTS.md.
